caption: The drawing features a single object positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The object is a lantern, rendered in grayscale, suggesting it is made of metal. The lantern has a tall, rectangular body with a handle attached to one side. Its front has a door or panel with a latch, bordered by raised edges. The top of the lantern comes to a peaked roof with a small circular hole near the apex and a short, conical chimney-like structure protruding from the roof. Shading is used to create dimensionality and to indicate the reflective quality and texture of the metal surface. No additional objects or decorative elements are present in the composition, which is minimalist, with the lantern occupying a central position and surrounded by ample empty space. The artist's name, "B. RESNICK," is inscribed in small letters in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Lantern
